person_note: The controlling narrator is nonparticipating and narrates Reacher and other characters in the third person. Numerous interior Goodreads passages sustain that position, while the authorized opening independently uses third-person narration and whole-book sources explicitly confirm the perspective. First-person forms in q03724 and q03737 are character speech, and the visible you forms are dialogue or generic rhetoric rather than second-person base narration. No source or passage indicates sustained first- or second-person sections; the opening-only limitation of the publisher extract is resolved by the distributed interior quotes and whole-book POV analyses.
